name: clinical-do-map
description: Review terminology mappings against local vocabularies with explicit decisions, domain-specific checks, and an auditable CSV workflow.

interface.shortDescription: Map and review terminology with an audit trail.
interface.longDescription: Search local Athena or canonical terminology exports, review every source row using domain and research context, and apply validated changes with backups and source hash checks.
defaultPrompt: Use $do-map to review my terminology mapping and research priorities.
